messages:
Maria Chen: Quick thread 30 we need final decisions on replay gating and the A/B follow-up for Tuesday's webinar. Two asks: 1) immediate replay flow (0-24h) and 2) gated full recording after 7 days (to drive MQLs). Need owners and copy by EOD.
Ajay Patel: I can wire the HubSpot + Zapier bits. Share exact form IDs and the gating URL details. Also: do we want separate UTMs per email variant?
Olivia Rivera: Yes on UTMs. We'll run subject line A/B in the immediate thank-you (50/50 split). Subjects: A) "Replay + key takeaways from Redwood Live" B) "You missed it? Watch the demo + top benchmarks". Track opens->CTR->trial click.
Rina Desai: Legal wants explicit consent checkbox on the gated form: "I agree to be contacted about Redwood products and accept the privacy policy". HubSpot property = legal_consent. Also need org-level company size capture (company_size).
Samir Kapoor: Captioning note: immediate replay should include auto transcript. For gated full recording we should upload QC'd captions. Assign Content Ops for caption QC.
Ben Holt: Zoom settings: cloud recording ON, alternative host Olivia, local backup on my laptop. Export name format: redwood_webinar_2026-04-07_{starttime}. ZoomBot will post link when ready.
Maria Chen: Gated flow details: public highlight reel (3 clips) free at 0-24h. Full edited recording available after 7 days behind a short MQL form (email, company, role, consent). If they filled the original registration, pre-fill email and show shorter form. Goal: convert engaged non-customers into sales contacts.
Ajay Patel: HubSpot specifics: immediate flow -> list id 8342 -> send thank-you email (A/B). Gated full replay form id = 7c9d1e. Zap: form submit -> create/update contact -> add tag "webinar_full_replay_request" -> if company_size > 500 then add to queue "AE-high" else "SDR-nurture".
Olivia Rivera: Email cadence for registrants: Attended: 0h thank-you + link to highlights (A/B subject test) -> 48h follow-up with 2-min clip -> 7d send gated full recording CTA. No-shows: 0h replay email with highlights and invite to watch full recording (gated).
Rina Desai: Privacy bits in emails: include unsubscribe link and link to privacy policy. For EU registrants, ensure we include data processing notice and route EU leads through Private deployment consent flow (tag: eu_data).
Samir Kapoor: Metrics to report by next week: registration -> attendance %, subject A vs B open & CTR, gated form conversion rate, % of gated requests that become MQLs within 30 days. We'll track via HubSpot and GA events.
Ajay Patel: A/B tracking plan: add utm_content=subjectA or subjectB and include email header property hs_email_subject_variant. I'll push a test list to staging.
Ben Holt: Ops checklist for post-event:
- Once cloud recording available, OpsBot will push raw to s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-04-07/raw
- Content edits -> captions QC -> edited -> s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-04-07/edited
- Public highlights will be uploaded to Vimeo unlisted and linked in the 0-24h emails
- Full edited video will be uploaded to gated page with time-limited access token (expires in 30 days)
OpsBot: Archive and upload automation scheduled. After cloud recording finished, copy to s3 and notify #marketing with presigned link. Gated page token service endpoint: https://assets.redwood.example.com/token. Token TTL: 30 days.
Maria Chen: Who owns clip selection? Olivia + Ben split: Olivia curates two story clips, Ben does the product demo clip. Rina to review any compliance-sensitive lines.
Olivia Rivera: I'll draft both email bodies and two subject lines. Rina, will add privacy copy for EU/UK. Ajay, put staging zap in place and provide test users for A/B.
Ajay Patel: Staging zap done. Sample test contacts: test+subjectA@redwood.test and test+subjectB@redwood.test. Mapping snippet:
```nemail -> contact.email
company -> contact.company
role -> contact.jobtitle
company_size -> contact.hs_company_size
utm_campaign -> contact.hs_utm_campaign
consent -> contact.legal_consent
```n
Rina Desai: Also: ensure we don't gate full recording for registrants who already converted to trial before day 7. If contact.lifetime_value > 0 or property has trial_started=true, then bypass gating and mark as "already-converted".
Samir Kapoor: QA items: test pre-fill behavior (registration vs fresh visitor), ensure token expires properly, test caption sync on gated player, verify GA events fire for play start / 25% / 50% / 100%.
Maria Chen: Final approvals: Olivia approve copy by 3pm PT, Ajay confirm prod zap by 4pm, OpsBot confirm token service health check by 4:30pm. If all green, deploy flows and schedule the A/B test.
Olivia Rivera: Copy drafted and added to /shared/marketing/webinars/2026-04-07/copy-v1. Subject A and B included and localized fallback for EU.
Ajay Patel: Prod zap deployed. HubSpot lists created. A/B split validated with 1000 synthetic test requests in staging.
OpsBot: Token service health: OK. Presigned link test successful. Archive job tested.
Ben Holt: Ran a short recording test and uploaded to the staging gated player. Token TTL honored.
Maria Chen: Great 30 we'll monitor results. Post-mortem next Friday with metrics and recommended next steps (scale gating or open access). Thanks team. :tada:
ZoomBot: Recording completed by Ben Holt. Cloud file: https://zoom.us/recording/def456. Duration: 00:58:12.
Maria Chen: Please keep this thread pinned to the event doc and ping me if any blockers pop up.
